commitNote: The harness, loadtest/competitors/ and MicroProxy at this commit, run through loadtest/competitors/dedicated/bootstrap.sh (RUN=1, JDK=25). The raw results, GC logs and the follow-up runs are on the perf/gcp-20261016 branch.

notMeasured.reason: its kernel (Linux 7.0) charges TCP socket buffers to the proxy's memory cgroup, and with 200 slow readers the buffers alone filled most of the 512 MB cap within a second (290 to 490 MB, against 16 to 56 MB of the proxy's own memory), so the cgroup's OOM killer ended the run for five of the six proxies whatever the proxy itself held
